messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
['The most recent ALERTS for your account are now available to download online.', 'This is the last observation to indicate you as of 08 Oct 2016 that you have not yet updated your iTunes ID information.', 'YOUR ACCOUNT HAS BEEN FLAGGED AS ONE OF THE NUMEROUS ACCOUNTS THAT NEEDS TO BE REVIEWED.', 'All accounts have been temporary suspended until leach person completes our secure on-line form.', 'OUR SECURITY DEPARTMENT HAVE NOTICED AN ILLEGAL MONEY TRANSFER FROM your HSBC internet banking account.', "Methought you'd like to know that Amazon shipped your item, and that this completes your order.", 'This e-mail has been sent to you by BT Internet to inform you that we were unable to process your most recent payment of bill.', 'Your Internet Banking Password was entered incorrectly 3 times.', 'Your subscription is on hold.', 'We recently reviewed your account, and suspect that your HSBC account may have been accessed by an unauthorized third party.', 'During a recent screening, we noticed an issue regarding your account.', 'We regret to inform you that we had to lock your Lloyds TSB account access because we have reasons to believe that it may have been compromised by outside parties.', 'We are unable to process this payment to your account as your details has not been updated', 'Unfortunately, your recent transactions was declined because your Co-operative Bank online account is currently restricted.', 'we have noticed invalid login attempts into your account, due to this we are temporarily limiting and restricting your account access until we confirm your identity.', 'Meanwhile, this fund is presently in a Security Vault, in (Europe) where it was first transferred to him for claims before his death on December 2003.', 'As an additional security measure your access to Online Banking has been limited.', 'We recently reviewed your account, and we suspect an unauthorized ATM based transaction.', 'On 29 Aug 2016, the card was removed from your PayPal account.', 'To protect your accounts, our monitoring process recently suspended your online service.', "In accordance with Egg's User Agreement, your account access will remain limited until the issue has been resolved."]

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

content: {"summary": "We provide account and transaction updates, alert you to suspicious activity, payment issues, or access restrictions, and request action to restore service."}
